r: Please show me what you have to trade.
What can you tell me about the town and local area?
I'm looking for my brother, Andor. He looks a bit like me.

cornith_1.m: Stoutford is not a big town, but it used to be important.

cornith_1_1.m: We are on the road to Blackwater mountain, so many traders used to pass through Stoutford and stay at the inn.

cornith_1_2.m: That's all changed though. The path to Blackwater mountain has been blocked by a rockfall. There is also the prison that's just east of here.

cornith_1_3.m: Flagstone prison. We never liked it being so close. Who would? But recently something happened, and it was overrun by monsters.

cornith_1_4.m: There's a guard that protects the path, but without a good reason to come this way most people choose not to risk it. And then of course, there are the monsters coming from the south.
r: I'm tired of hearing about your problems.

cornith_1_5.m: We think they come from Mount Galmore, and they keep attacking our town.
r: I'm sorry to hear about all the trouble, but there's something else I wanted to talk about.

cornith_2.m: Sorry, I don't recall seeing anyone like that recently. Most visitors go to the inn though, so you might have more luck asking there.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
